name: cold-pain
subject: The content cost problem for {{outlet}}
textbody:
Dear {{name}},

Publishers like {{outlet}} pay ₹800–1,500 per article to freelancers — or ₹15,000–45,000 per month per writer — and still can't cover the full news cycle.

I built an automated news engine that publishes sourced, SEO-ready articles in your brand 24/7, for a flat monthly fee. Every article is human-approved before going live.

Worth a look? I can show you the live site in 15 minutes. If it's not up to your standard, I'll take the feedback.{{unsubscribe}}
